_readme: Filled in from the QA App Test project on 2026-08-28. 'minorIssue' currently points at the same option as 'approvedWithComments' since Asana only has one 'Approved with Issues Flagged' option covering both - confirm this is what you want. 'notApplicable' is used when Pre-Production Approval gets explicitly skipped in the app (see the Skip Pre-Production button) - Sample has no matching option since Sample can't be skipped, so it stays null there. qaqcDriveLinkFieldGid is the GID of the plain text 'QA/QC Drive Link' field on the task (not an enum field, so it takes a text field GID here, no separate option GIDs).
